notes.title: Hop to it! - OUT NOW
notes.content: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]Hop to it! is out now! I've had a lot of fun testing it over the 2 months I've been making it, and hopefully you do too![/p][previewyoutube="dmy26shaG6M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]What to expect in Hop to it![/b][/p][list][*][p]Groundbreaking sentient pogo stick physics[/p][/*][*][p]Serene city views as you plummet to the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Helpful tips to let you know what you could improve on[/p][/*][*][p]Challenging but rewarding movement[/p][/*][*][p]Several areas with unique challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoint mode for practice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]- Tom[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 + new languages! 🎉
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone who tried the demo so far, I've made a couple changes based on some of the feedback so far and updated the demo with loads of new additional languages![/p][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added a timer to the top of the screen to keep track of your progress/stress you out :) ⏱️[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with some settings not saving properly[/p][/*][*][p]Made the demo a bit longer to give more of a taste of the full game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the HUD ui to be a bit less cluttered and cleaner 🧹[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Languages 🌍[/h2][list][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]- Tom[/p]
